value.text: In modern parlance, some stuff with mass is matter--baryons and leptons, some is antimatter--antibaryons and antileptons, and then there is some other stuff, mesons, that have mass but apparently are neither matter nor antimatter!  Clearly it is no longer satisfactory to define matter as that which has mass.
